caption: Snowsight's left navigation: Worksheets, Dashboards, Data. A dashboard is a saved collection of tiles, each backed by a worksheet.
One tile of a real Security Dashboard: login failures broken out by user and failure reason — EXT_AUTHN_DENIED, INCORRECT_USERNAME_PASSWORD, JWT_TOKEN_INVALID, and more.
A tile titled "Privileged Access: ACCOUNTADMIN Grants," querying SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE.QUERY_HISTORY for every successful GRANT of the ACCOUNTADMIN role, newest first.
"Least Privileged Access: Most Dangerous Person" — users ranked by total privilege count. A dashboard turns an abstract access-review task into one bar chart.

code:
SELECT
  user_name || ' granted the ' || role_name
    || ' role on ' || end_time AS description,
  query_text AS statement
FROM query_history
WHERE
  execution_status = 'SUCCESS'
  AND query_type = 'GRANT'
  AND query_text ILIKE '%grant%accountadmin%to%'
ORDER BY end_time DESC;
caption: Every dashboard tile is a worksheet query first. This one scans QUERY_HISTORY for ACCOUNTADMIN grants — the chart is just that result set, charted.

subtitle: Auditing covers your own account — sharing extends governance to others.
